# Python packages for .github/workflows/pr-sbom-tests.yml, pinned by version and
# hash. The hashes are the py3-none-any wheels and the CPython 3.12 manylinux
# x86_64 wheels, so the job pins Python 3.12 on an x86_64 runner.
#
# sbom-cve-check is the version the layer's python3-sbom-cve-check recipe
# builds; the job fails if the two differ. Its wheel holds the same source tree
# as the sdist the recipe fetches. spdx-python-model is its only dependency on
# Python 3.12; pyyaml is in the recipe's RDEPENDS. jsonschema and what it pulls
# in are for the tests that check reports against the schema.
